TC-08/S18.title: Handoff summaries failed: everyone listed, chart shown with Retry, no placeholders
TC-08/S18.detail: Local 8b4be94a, fresh @roundai.test accounts; no model: handoff/persistence:ensure answered at the Convex socket (ts 0, nothing scheduled), every ai/* refused, charts carry stored stand-in summaries re-inserted with `convex import --append` (ho-support.ts); tripwire 'no model call' on every run. Charts stored with handoffStatus 'error'. Passed: all patients listed, banner '2 summaries couldn’t be generated — the chart is shown instead.' + Retry (Retry re-asks ensure), Send enabled, failed card keeps every open task once under To-Do, discharge task never under Pending Results, point under Active Issues, NH same; no email/share fallback. FAILED: a failed chart with no age and no diagnosis (H4) shows 'Room 4B-30 · ?y · undefined' on the card and '?yo admitted for undefined.' in the sheet and the copied/sent text (templateStruct / HandoffOverlay header). Recorded Q11: a failed card itself is not marked as chart-based (only the banner); Q2: failed card shows only Active Issues + To-Do.
TC-08/S18.statedNote: scope: the '?yo'/placeholder part is our extension (extraPart); stated part (3.5 clear message, retry, not stuck) passed
